name: Pain-reflecting
body:
Aura faint necromancy; CL 3rd; Price +1 bonus; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This armor is decorated with the images of bones.

Three times per day, when the wearer of pain-reflecting armor is dealt damage by a melee attack the armor deals 1d8+ 3 damage to the attacking creature. They may make a Will Save DC 14 to reduce this damage by half.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells inflict light wounds
